title: ABACUS printed EXX total uses the active-ABFS + Spencer truncated kernel, so cut-vs-full Coulomb differences are not evidence of a bad Coulomb matrix
symptom: For GeTe/SnSe the printed ABACUS EXX energy is -95.32359552 / -90.91615538 Ha per cell, while the LibRPA full-direct occupied trace is -92.60441917 / -350.93993950 Ha — differences of tens to hundreds of Ha that look like a catastrophic Coulomb-matrix failure.
root_cause: The value ABACUS prints comes from the active ABFS (physical NAO products generated with exx_pca_thr 1e-4 and rotated) together with the Spencer spherical truncated kernel (source/source_lcao/module_ri/RPA_LRI.hpp:576, active basis construction in Exx_LRI.hpp:417) and a plain-CVC pseudo-inverse with relative threshold lambda > lambda_max * 1e-5. The external plus-g raw ABFS, the raw Cs and the shrink mapping do not enter that printed total. The LibRPA trace instead uses the full-direct kernel, so the two numbers are computed with different kernels and thresholds and are not comparable. In addition, empty states have zero occupation, so a catastrophic empty-band shift need not enter the occupied trace: a finite total does not prove the operator is correct (ABACUS total energy is not independently validated).
minimal_fix: Compare like with like: audit the printed EXX against the same kernel/basis/threshold path (active ABFS + Spencer cut + the same Cs inverse threshold) and treat only a same-kernel discrepancy as a Coulomb bug. Record the kernel, basis (raw vs active ABFS) and pseudo-inverse threshold next to every EXX number.
validation: Recompute both traces with matched kernel/basis/threshold and show the difference collapses to the small residual expected from the cut-vs-full kernel difference; separately inspect the empty-band energies, since a correct occupied trace does not imply correct empty states.
avoid: Do not call the raw cut-vs-full difference an error without matching kernel and pseudo-inverse threshold ('核与筛选阈值不匹配，不能把差值直接判为错误'), and do not conclude the operator is validated because the printed total energy is finite.
